items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS/MECHANICS: WASD held (duration-based); clock advances ~10 in-game min per successful step; blocked moves freeze the clock. Waiting usually doesn't advance time (sometimes ~10 min outdoors while fishing). C = use tool/rod (hold to charge cast; tap to hook/reel); X = interact (door, mailbox, sign, bin); E = inventory; M = map; number keys select toolbar slot. Toolbar: 1 axe, 2 pickaxe, 3 watering can, 4 hoe, 5 scythe, 6 Bamboo Pole, 7-9 catches/twig. Dialogues advance by left-clicking the text panel; gift icon at panel bottom-right advances gifts; SKIP button bottom-right ends cutscenes; sign panels close via their small X close button; Willy's letter closed with Escape, Morris's with the top-right X.

FISHING LOOP (verified; Sunfish caught day 5): face the water (casts travel in the facing direction; wrong facing = silent failure); hold C ~0.9s to cast; bobber lands ~2-4 tiles ahead in water; wait for a bite. Genuine bite seen as large 'HIT!' text over the water (day 5, 8:40 pm) -> pressing C opened the bar minigame -> hold LMB raises the green bar, release lowers; keep the green bar overlapping the fish to fill the right-side progress meter; caught Sunfish. Nibble cues (pink/red-topped bobber, splash rings, purple '!' markers) usually only reel in when C is pressed, but some dip-presses produced direct catches (Joja Cola x2 day 6; Broken Glasses day 8) without a visible minigame. C reels in anytime; recast to refresh a stale cast. Verify facing before casting.

ENERGY: depletes with actions; messages 'You're starting to feel exhausted' / 'You seem sluggish from over-exertion'; at zero energy casts seemed to fail (white puff) though late-day casts sometimes still landed; restores to full at 6:00 am. Drinking Joja Cola did not visibly restore energy (unclear).

SHIPPING/INCOME: face the shipping bin (porch, right of mailbox), X opens UI; click items to move them to the bin slot, click OK (bottom-right) to confirm. Payout appears on the day-end earnings screen: day 7 shipped Sunfish + Joja Cola x2 -> 'Fishing 80G, Total 80G' -> OK -> new day; gold 329->409. Toolbar catch slots emptied after shipping.

DAY END: bed sleep never triggered (~8+ attempts: standing on bed, X at pillow, C at bed, lying in bed). At 2:00 am a pass-out occurs with a small fee (~40-50g): save screen, skill-earnings screen (click OK), 'Day N of Spring, Year 1' card, then 6:00 am in bed with full energy.

HOUSE: exit via the bottom-center-left alcove notch (~x0.36) by walking into it and holding S (S+A works) onto the porch. Enter by aligning with the door tile on the south porch and pressing X (worked day 4 ~11:50 pm and day 7 ~midnight); simply walking onto the door tile sometimes did nothing. Bed is on the right side of the interior; exit notch at bottom-center. Mailbox: face it and press X from an adjacent tile (worked day 4 for the Joja medical-bill letter); repeated failures from porch distance.

FARM GEOGRAPHY: porch has mailbox (right) and shipping bin (further right). Yard south of the house is cluttered with weeds/stones/twigs; pickaxe/scythe strikes on boulders showed no effect; mushroom clusters appear decorative (X does nothing). Pond in the farm's south-east: brown north rim around y~0.55 with water below; productive casting spots at x~0.60-0.68 (also ~0.70) standing just above the rim facing south; stump at ~x0.70 east bank; waterfall at the pond's east side. East fence gap by a purple tree exits to the road; road runs east to the bus stop with sign 'Bus Stop / Pelican Town'.

BUS STOP: bus at west, road along top, sign arrows point east, stairs at the right edge, player walks a grass strip south of the road. Days 3 and 7 failed to find the town entrance here even though map M showed Pelican Town east/south-east. Beware sprite misidentification and camera clamping: the right-edge 'E' bar is stamina UI, not an exit; a red-clad edge figure was repeatedly mistaken for the farmer.

PELICAN TOWN (reached only on day 2): from the bus stop road's east end, D+W led to the stone plaza; crossroads with lampposts; brick fountain; paved walk south; brick buildings; blue ship-wheel fish shop; sewer manhole and riverbank; stone bridge south -> fade -> beach pier with Willy and a bench. Willy event: X on Willy -> dialogue -> gift icon -> 'You received a Bamboo Pole!' -> SKIP -> normal HUD; pole in slot 6. Return: north over the stone bridge -> town -> northwest road -> bus stop -> farm.

OTHER: letters - Willy's invitation (day 2), Joja 50g medical bill for passing out (day 4). Screen-fraction coordinates are estimates, not world coordinates.

CURRENT STATE (Mon. 8, Day 8 of Spring Year 1): 12:00 pm; gold 409g; energy full; bamboo pole (slot 6) equipped; Broken Glasses in slot 7; farmer above the pond's north rim (~x0.61-0.68, y~0.42); bobber floating in the pond at ~(0.78,0.72) awaiting a bite cue. Plan: press C at a dip/'HIT!'; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish; later ship catches via the porch bin before 2 am.

UNRESOLVED: hook inputs Return key and right-click untested; whether failed casts came from zero energy or bad facing; whether food restores energy; town entry from the bus stop remains unsolved.
